about.title: Crafting Mobile and Web Application with Passion
about.descriptionPart1: Originally aspiring Electrical Engineer, I developed a passion for Web Development. Starting from {javascript}, I developed Web Applications thorough my work experiences and my free time using various technologies such as SPA with {react} and {vue}, and SSR built with {next} and {nuxt} more recently.

about.descriptionPart3: Career path led me to experience Backend Development with {node}, as well as Database Management, {sql}, and to manage environments and deployment through {aws}.
